_comment: EXAMPLE · S3 destination / formats — what a @subscriber writes. `paths` declares one WRITE SLOT per entry, fed by input_tables in the same order, one returned frame each; a destination path names ONE file (no wildcards); a returned None writes NOTHING — no empty file, and the previous file is left alone. Seven sinks over the same seeded table so only the format differs: write_parquet (AUTO from the extension — exact types, nothing to configure), write_avro, write_json (a text format; tz-aware timestamps are normalised to UTC ISO-8601, where parquet/avro keep the column's zone), write_csv (defaults — note a null becomes an EMPTY FIELD), write_csv_dialect (writer format_cfg: separator, null_value, date_format, float_precision, quote_style — side-typed, so a reader key here fails at decoration time), write_two_files, write_nothing. One function per file under functions/s3_dest_formats/. Run: `tdx-xp oneshot --suite examples/s3_dest_formats --keep`.
